entries.reason: Six localized graphic sets preserve the original loader and nontext diagrams; ROM reconstruction matches the generated previews.
entries.historical_reason: The Japanese version loads six pre-rendered full-screen graphic sets through src/berry_fix_graphics.c; it has no equivalent text-string table. Porting the US C strings requires a separate graphics/text rendering replacement, not an address-based text override.

entries.reason: 96 nickname/trainer pairs resolved only at display consumers, including saved painting captions. Original opponent, live contest, saved winner and link data remain unchanged.
entries.historical_reason: Wokann defines gContestOpponents as ContestPokemon records. The nickname and trainerName fields are copied into gContestMons and transmitted verbatim by contest link code. Replacing them inline with renderer mode bytes would alter exchanged contest data. A display-only conversion must be designed separately.

entries.reason: 121 names use three-byte display resource tokens in the original 11-byte fields of relocated 28-byte records; all 11 name-base interior references redirected.
entries.historical_reason: The US commit expands Decoration.name from the Japanese fixed 11-byte inline field to 16 bytes. Many Chinese names do not fit the Japanese record layout, so an inline replacement would overwrite adjacent decoration data. A name-display redirect is required.
